stage1.impression: A clear cast cylinder with flat silvered lens voids and a blue-edged top sits on a glossy black floor in front of a grey cove. The glass is plausible, but the interior reads as murky grey water, the left silhouette burns to a white bar, a black slab intrudes at the frame's left edge, and the black base reads as a grey slate table rather than a record.

blocking_9: The body's interior must read clear and bright, not murky: body [480,500,1320,860] median 137 sits under the cove's 153, so the acrylic looks like grey water; it should sit at about 155 to 180 with the voids' silver rims as the brightest marks inside
No clipped bars on the silhouette: left edge [435,500,470,860] is 31% clipped
Both silhouettes carry a dark edge line that draws the cylinder; only the left has one, the right edge [1310,500,1340,860] is a pale 167
The black matte label and the black vinyl are separable and black: label 80 to 97, vinyl 88 to 93, both read as one grey slab
The vinyl reads as a record (grooves, concentric sheen), not a polished black table: floor [150,520,380,700] is a flat 88 with a range of 14
No set pieces in frame: the black slab at [0,0,110,400] (median 15) cuts the cove at the left edge

changes.problem: The clear acrylic reads as murky grey water because the cove seen through it is darker than the cove behind the object.

evidence.measured: body lum_median 137.4 (x profile 97, 140, 155, 147, 143, 149, 127, 86) against cove [300,0,1700,250] median 153 and the band above the top [600,230,1200,290] at 191; the interior is a flat mid grey with refracted grey shapes

changes.expected: A brighter cove refracted through the body; the interior lifts to about 155 to 175 so the voids read as silver air in a clear solid, while the band above the top stays below clipping.

changes.problem: The left silhouette is a burned white bar the full height of the body, most likely the tall rimR strip refracted across the cylinder.
changes.expected: The left edge keeps a crisp bright line that peaks around 230 to 245 without clipping.

changes.problem: The matte black label (#1E1E1E) is lit straight from above to the value of the vinyl, so it reads as a grey felt mat instead of black paper lit only by light coming through the weight's base.

evidence.measured: label lum_median 96.8 (left side [340,760,420,860] 80.5), vinyl beside it [1420,520,1650,700] 93.3

changes.expected: The label falls to about 45 to 65 away from the base, so the glow gathered under the weight stands out against it.

changes.problem: A black vertical slab (flagL) sits in frame at the left edge and cuts the cove.
changes.expected: The left edge shows only cove, about 110 to 160, while flagL still darkens the right silhouette by refraction.

changes.problem: The right silhouette has no dark line, so the right side of the cylinder dissolves into the pale cove.

evidence.measured: lum_median 167.3, p5 41.7; the left side has a dark edge, the right does not

change.to: matte black card #111111, 160 x 300 mm, at (230, 110, 0 to 300), square to the object, out of frame

changes.expected: A dark edge line of about 60 to 120 runs down the right silhouette and matches the left one, so the cylinder is drawn on both sides.

changes.problem: The LP reads as a polished black table: no grooves, no concentric sheen, the same flat grey as the label.

change.to: concentric groove normal map at about 0.1 mm pitch with a 1 to 2 mm lead-in/run-out band, anisotropic roughness tangent to the grooves (0.05 along, 0.3 across), base #0C0C0C

changes.expected: The vinyl shows the arc-shaped anisotropic highlights of a record and drops to a darker base, with lum range across the patch of 30 to 90.

out_of_scope.why: The top [520,310,1300,420] reads as a dark blue pool (median 122, delta E 27 from a pale #BFE0F5) against the 191 band behind it. The tint comes from the measured transmission chart and is fixed. c1 and c3 change what it reflects, but its colour is not a setting.

out_of_scope.request: Less blue in the voids on the left side
out_of_scope.why: Voids [500,500,700,750] mirror the blue lamina by total internal reflection. That is the fixed optics of air in acrylic.
